summary: First testing iteration for Elena Private Lounge. All 9 backend pytest tests passed (root, unauth 401, invalid session_id 401, seeded /auth/me, chat message+history sorted asc, chat clear, photo generation end-to-end incl. file serving+gallery, video generation completed within 3min, logout invalidates session). All frontend UI checks pass: /login renders hero + login button, button navigates to https://auth.emergentagent.com with encoded redirect, /dashboard without cookie redirects to /login, seeded session_token cookie loads full dashboard (header, status indicator, player container, chat container, photo/video buttons, gallery), chat send returns Elena reply within ~5s.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py logout: response.delete_cookie ignores current cookie's samesite/secure attributes across some Starlette versions - low risk but consider making delete params match exactly the set params (already does).

Photo/video generation background tasks catch all exceptions and mark job failed - good; however _run_image_generation writes raw bytes directly (images[0] is bytes) which is correct only if emergentintegrations returns bytes; confirmed working.
chat_message endpoint catches all LLM exceptions with a graceful fallback message - good UX, but consider logging retry_count for observability.

media_file endpoint is public (no auth) with UUID-based filenames as security-by-obscurity - documented in code but is a minor privacy consideration for a 'private' lounge; acceptable given UUID entropy.
test_credentials: Seeded via mongosh per /app/memory/test_credentials.md; session tokens created directly in Mongo (test_session_fe_<ts>).
seed_data_creation: Inserted user {email=bryanugalde290@gmail.com} and user_sessions doc directly into MongoDB test_database for both backend pytest and frontend Playwright runs.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully working. Video generation via Sora 2 completed within ~3min in this run — do not rely on that; test_generate_video_pending polls up to 3 min and pytest.skip()s if still pending. To seed a session use the mongosh snippet in /app/memory/test_credentials.md. Frontend cookie domain: elena-vee.preview.emergentagent.com, secure=True, sameSite='None', httpOnly=True. Note that /api/auth/me sets cookie via Set-Cookie only on /api/auth/session; direct cookie injection for testing works fine. ChatPanel automatically renders a greeting message from Elena on first mount even if history is empty (this is normal).
